name: The Unity - Children of the Cathedral
description:
{"ops":[{"attributes":{"underline":true,"italic":true,"bold":true},"insert":"UNITY - PRAY - FOLLOW"},{"insert":"

Let’s get one thing straight right out of the gate: "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"This deck is "},{"attributes":{"underline":true,"bold":true},"insert":"not"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":" trying to be the fastest at the table."},{"insert":" If you want to combo off on turn three, you’re in the wrong lab.

This deck is designed to create board states that shift, mutate, and grow constantly. The goal was to build a deck that actually feels like The Master is running the show. The Unity isn't something you just summon from your hand—it’s something you meticulously build.

This is a Sultai value engine built to flood graveyards, spread radiation, and steal the best threats on the board. With "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The Master, Transcendent"},{"insert":" running the show, your goal is to mill yourself and your opponents, then tap The Master to snatch freshly milled creatures and turn them into 3/3 green Mutants. You back this up with rad counters, +1/+1 counter synergies, and classic mill payoffs. We aren't looking for infinite combos here; we win through grinding attrition, radioactive drain, and overwhelming board states.

The Game Plan"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The Early Game: Prime the Pump"},{"insert":" 
Ramp hard and start milling early. Drop your mana dorks and rocks alongside cheap mill engines like "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Ruin Crab"},{"insert":" or "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Mesmeric Orb"},{"insert":". You want those graveyards overflowing by the time you reach the mid-game.

"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The Mid Game: Harvest and Mutate"},{"insert":" 
Cast The Master and start harvesting. Remember, he only grabs creatures milled "},{"attributes":{"italic":true},"insert":"this turn"},{"insert":", so sequence your mill effects right before you tap him. Start layering your board with draw engines, counter multipliers like "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Hardened Scales"},{"insert":", and your Mutant lords to turn your 3/3s into massive threats.

Closing the Game"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"You have a few ways to cross the finish line:
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Mill:"},{"insert":" Wipe out their libraries entirely with "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Phenax, God of Deception"},{"insert":" or "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Court of Cunning"},{"insert":"."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Drain:"},{"insert":" Bleed the table dry using "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Syr Konrad, the Grim"},{"insert":" paired with "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Mindcrank"},{"insert":"."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Beatdown:"},{"insert":" Turn your oversized, radioactive Mutants sideways and swing for lethal."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Backup Plan:"},{"insert":" If The Master gets hated out, "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Muldrotha, the Gravetide"},{"insert":" steps in to keep the graveyard train rolling."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
Pro Tips for Piloting"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Timing is everything."},{"insert":" Always trigger your mill "},{"attributes":{"italic":true},"insert":"before"},{"insert":" activating The Master so you actually have legal targets to steal."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Tyvar is your best friend."},{"insert":" "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler"},{"insert":" lets you use The Master the turn he comes down and untaps him for double the stealing."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Maximize your proliferate."},{"insert":" Hold your proliferate spells until you have multiple targets online. Grow your rad counters, +1/+1 counters, and planeswalkers all at once for maximum value."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Watch your library."},{"insert":" Keep "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Elixir of Immortality"},{"insert":" handy so you do not accidentally deck yourself under your own heavy self-mill."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"The All-Stars"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The Enablers:"},{"insert":" "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Mesmeric Orb"},{"insert":" and "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Ruin Crab"},{"insert":" fill the yards passively and pressure the whole table."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The Drainers:"},{"insert":" "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Syr Konrad, the Grim"},{"insert":" and "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Mindcrank"},{"insert":" turn every milled card and point of damage into a nightmare for your opponents."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The Multipliers:"},{"insert":" "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Hardened Scales"},{"insert":", "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Corpsejack Menace"},{"insert":", and "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The Wise Mothman"},{"insert":" turn your baseline 3/3 Mutants into terrifying beaters."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"The Closers:"},{"insert":" "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Phenax, God of Deception"},{"insert":" and "},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Altar of Dementia"},{"insert":" let you pivot to a direct mill finish if the red zone is stalled."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"underline":true,"italic":true,"bold":true},"insert":"Welcome to The Unity."},{"insert":"
